title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Rises 1.3% to $143.50 (Nov 18)
summary: SPCX rose 1.27% to close at $143.50 on Nov 18, ahead of the Nasdaq. The SpaceX news around the move: a Texas data center permit and Citadel's 13F.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Rose


No financial media report reviewed for this article tied Wednesday's gain to a SpaceX announcement made during the session, so the move stands against a market where the Nasdaq rose and the Dow fell. The company news around it was about its Texas data center plans and a large investor's filing.


According to[POLITICO](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/texas-issues-air-permit-massive-223921553.html) , in a report published late Tuesday, the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) issued an air permit on Monday for SpaceX's $24 billion data center and gas-fired power plant on a 444-acre site near Brownsville. The permit approves 35 natural gas-burning turbines producing 750 megawatts, and the plant would not be connected to the grid. SpaceX did not respond to requests for comment, POLITICO reported.


After the close,[Reuters](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/texas-resumes-issuing-data-center-181646645.html) reported that TCEQ had resumed its normal permit review process for data centers, after Governor Greg Abbott temporarily blocked air permits for all data center projects. The resumption followed notice from the state grid operator that it had collected community impact review information.


Also after the close,[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ken-griffin-dumps-spacex-amazon-223005217.html) reported that Ken Griffin's Citadel cut its SpaceX holding by 94% in the third quarter, according to its latest 13F filing. A 13F filing reports holdings as of the quarter's end, not during Wednesday's session.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- The Texas air permit reported by POLITICO covers the 750-megawatt gas-fired plant planned to power SpaceX's data center near Brownsville.
- Reuters reported that Texas has resumed its normal review of data center air permits after the pause.
- SPCX finished 0.85 percentage points ahead of the Nasdaq Composite on a day the Dow fell 1.32%.


### Risks


- Democratic Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has promised a data center moratorium once she takes office in January, and TD Cowen said the outgoing administration's permitting push reduces hopes for a near-term policy deal between her and developers, per Reuters.
- FracTracker Alliance and Public Citizen filed a complaint alleging SpaceX began construction without a required Clean Air Act permit, according to POLITICO.
- Citadel cut its SpaceX stake by 94% in the third quarter, per Benzinga, and Wednesday's gain came on volume 16.27% below average.
